meta.method: Web search only (search-engine result summaries, 58 extended queries). Article pages could NOT be opened: page fetching failed for every host tried (www.gtabase.com, game8.co, thegta6map.com, www.dexerto.com are outside the session's allowed network domains), and the session's web-search budget ran out before all leads were followed. Every fact therefore rests on search summaries of the listed URLs, not on a first-hand read of the page.
meta.verified_rule: verified=true: at least two independent sources in the search results agree the item exists at that place, or it is documented by a major outlet. verified=false: single source, speculation, or no location.

status_values.disputed: exists, but sources disagree on the exact location or a key detail (see 'what'/'area')
status_values.unsolved: real in-game object whose meaning/purpose is unknown
status_values.unconfirmed: rumour/speculation without evidence - exclude from the map
status_values.debunked: hoax or disproved claim - exclude from the map

items.name: UFO abduction (start of the 'Alien Dreams' questline)
items.area: Rural dirt roads east of Port Gellhorn
items.landmark: Starlet Motel (the spot is north-west of it)
items.spot: Abandoned car with flashing/flickering lights and open doors on a dirt road; a trail leads from it into the woods where a UFO is abducting a person
items.conditions: Night only, after about 02:00 in-game (one guide prints '2 PM', almost certainly a typo). Available after reaching Chapter 2. Go alone (without the partner). Does not spawn every night - leave the area and retry.
items.what: Approach the car and follow the trail: the UFO abducts the player. A dream sequence follows with two puzzles: a 4-digit keypad (count the bars/lines of light above the keypad, one digit per column) and a light panel (make every light blue; one guide gives the button order 4-3-4-3-1). You wake up with the location of a research site (see 'Alien lab'). In-phone news about glowing lights in the sky hints at it.
items.codes: Dream keypad code differs per playthrough (derive it from the light bars above the keypad). Values reported by different guides: 2431, 3214, 2143, 2341, 1324.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; walkthroughs by VGC, Dexerto, Sportskeeda, KeenGamer, Beebom, bo3.gg
items.desc_ru: Ночью (после 02:00, со 2-й главы) на грунтовке к северо-западу от мотеля Starlet стоит брошенная машина с мигающими фарами: рядом НЛО похищает человека, а затем и вас. Во сне нужно решить головоломки с кодом и лампами - так начинается цепочка «Alien Dreams».

items.name: Alien lab / 'Abandoned Site' (fans call it Area 51)
items.spot: Fenced compound of concrete buildings with graffiti under a lattice radio mast; inside, a control room and a container holding an unconscious alien
items.conditions: Only after the UFO abduction and the dream sequence. On the way back a UFO intercepts you.
items.what: Final stage of the alien questline: open the container, pick up the unconscious alien and carry it out of the base, where the UFO meets you (the 'secret ending'). Reported reward: permanent bonuses to Health, Stamina and Focus; one guide lists a trophy called 'The Truth Is Out There', another says you wake up three in-game days later with a hidden achievement. Most guides put the site south of Hamlet in Pelican Valley; one guide says Mariana County.
items.codes: Same per-playthrough 4-digit code seen in the dream (see UFO abduction entry).
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; VGC, Sportskeeda, ShowGamer, holdtoreset, guided.news
items.desc_ru: Заброшенная огороженная база в болотах к югу от Хамлета, у аэродрома South Point. Внутри в контейнере лежит инопланетянин: вынесите его наружу к НЛО и получите постоянную прибавку к здоровью, выносливости и концентрации.

items.name: Mount Kalaga UFO (pre-release list claim)
items.what: A fan site page that predates launch lists a UFO at Mount Kalaga. No post-launch guide corroborates it; guides only say fans suspect the summit stone circle might trigger another UFO event.
items.origin: Pre-release fan speculation (gtavispot.com); not a documented discovery
items.desc_ru: Неподтверждённый слух о НЛО над горой Калага: источник - фанатская страница, написанная ещё до релиза. В вышедшей игре находку никто не подтвердил.

items.name: Skunk Ape (Bigfoot) sighting
items.region: Grassrivers / Mariana County (guides name it differently)
items.area: Swamps around Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet; across Gambit Bay from Key Lento
items.landmark: Cottonmouth Lake (dirt road on its south/east side, toward Gambit Bay); Jason's house in Key Lento is just across Gambit Bay
items.spot: The creature is found eating a deer carcass on/near a dirt road; it runs into the trees. The chase ends at a human-shaped wooden effigy standing beside a tree
items.conditions: No time or story gating reported; reachable from the start. Listen for a deep growl and follow it on foot.
items.what: Chase the Skunk Ape (the game's Bigfoot; locals also call him 'Mister Mangrove') into the woods. Inspecting the effigy releases fumes that knock you out; as you pass out you see huge feet approaching. One outlier guide (Mobalytics) puts the sighting in woods east of Watson Bay near Pelican River; Sportskeeda mentions marshland south of Watson Bay; other mentions include the Shoeless Keys.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery (first clips on launch day, reported by VGC's Jordan Middler); guides by PC Gamer, Game Rant, Beebom, esports.gg, Dread Central
items.desc_ru: В болотах у озера Коттонмаут (к югу от Хамлета, через залив Гамбит от дома Джейсона) можно застать Скунсовую обезьяну - местного бигфута, поедающего оленя. Погоня приводит к деревянному чучелу, после осмотра которого герой теряет сознание.

items.name: 'Skunk Apeology' - Kirk's Mr. Mangrove missions
items.spot: Kirk's flyers pinned at the two bars start the storyline
items.what: Side storyline about hunting the Skunk Ape: a three-effigy search that ends in a choice (guides mention capturing him). The questline itself is described by several guides (GTABites, Beebom, Dread Central); the two flyer spots come from a single search summary and were not cross-checked.
items.origin: Post-launch guides (GTABites, Beebom, Dread Central)
items.desc_ru: Побочная цепочка «Skunk Apeology» об охоте на Скунсовую обезьяну: листовки Кирка, по сообщениям гайдов, висят в баре Skeeter's в Хамлете и в Rusty Anchor на Ки-Ленто. Точки листовок подтверждены только одним источником.

items.name: Giant mutant crab ('Karkinos') and the Pelican Valley crab research outpost
items.area: Gullet Marsh (also spelled Gullett Marsh), south-west swamps
items.landmark: Abandoned crab research station with a dock
items.spot: Main building: side bedroom (writing on the floor), computer next to the safe; separate building at the end of the dock with a keypad
items.what: Three-step puzzle. 1) Read the writing on the side-bedroom floor and pick the password CLEAVES on the computer. 2) The computer hints at 'double success': the highlighted successful specimen is 0036, doubled = safe code 0072 (about $1,070 cash plus the dock code). 3) Dock building keypad 0212: legendary Crabshack VF5 SMG, a stash bag with $10,000 in marked bills and a jet ski. Leaving the computer triggers a cutscene in which a giant mutant crab attacks - follow the button prompts to shake it off.
items.codes: Computer password: CLEAVES; safe: 0072; dock building keypad: 0212
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; GameSpot, Game Rant, Yahoo, Sportskeeda, KeenGamer
items.desc_ru: Заброшенная станция по изучению крабов в болоте Gullet Marsh. Пароль компьютера CLEAVES, сейф 0072, дверь домика на причале 0212 - внутри легендарный ПП Crabshack VF5 и сумка с $10 000; по пути на героя нападает гигантский краб-мутант.

items.name: Kraken wreck (ship wrapped in tentacles)
items.area: Sea south of Catalan Bay and east of Peacock Bay
items.landmark: South-east of Gloriana Key; near the second oval-shaped underwater formation out from the Catalan Bay beach
items.spot: On the seabed: a wrecked ship tangled in giant tentacles
items.conditions: Boat required; wear scuba gear before diving.
items.what: A static underwater set piece. It does not move or attack; the steel beams and metal framing suggest it is the remains of an old attraction rather than a creature.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Game Rant, DualShockers, Sportskeeda, YouTube
items.desc_ru: На дне моря к юго-востоку от Глориана-Ки (южнее Каталан-Бэй) лежит корабль, опутанный щупальцами кракена. Это неподвижная декорация - судя по металлическому каркасу, остатки старого аттракциона; нужен акваланг.

items.name: Living sea monster / attacking Kraken claims
items.what: Some lists describe a giant living sea creature somewhere off Leonida. No verified location or trigger exists; the documented 'Kraken' is a static wreck prop (see Kraken wreck) and the only confirmed attacking 'monster' is the scripted giant crab at the Pelican Valley outpost.
items.origin: Aggregator lists (GameRiv, Middle East Gamer call it unconfirmed)
items.desc_ru: Слухи о живом морском чудовище у берегов Леониды не подтверждены: ни места, ни способа вызвать встречу никто не показал. Реально найденный «кракен» - неподвижная декорация на дне.

items.name: St. Lucia Lighthouse: ghost keepers, ghost ship and the Cursed Knife
items.region: Leonard County (north-east corner of the map; one guide says the in-game notes call it South East Leonida)
items.area: Little Hardin Island, the thin island across Millport Basin
items.spot: Ruined house west of the lighthouse (Frank's logbook next to the fireplace); dock near the lighthouse with a boat holding scuba gear; small wreck on the seabed east of the lighthouse; lighthouse balcony/top
items.conditions: Night. Start around midnight; sail east after 01:00; the ghost ship is seen from the top around 01:30. If dawn comes first, sleep and retry the next night.
items.what: 1) Read Frank's (blue) logbook in the ruined house west of the lighthouse. 2) Take the scuba gear from the boat at the dock and sail east after 01:00 until the engine dies in the fog; dive (a metal detector helps) to a small wreck and collect the Cursed Knife, a unique throwing knife. 3) Return to the top of the lighthouse before morning: two glowing ghost keepers fight on the balcony and one goes over the railing, and a glowing green galleon appears offshore (binoculars help). The story implies a keeper named Godfrey was driven mad by the ship.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Game Rant, Sportskeeda, Middle East Gamer, YouTube walkthroughs
items.desc_ru: Маяк Сент-Люсия на острове Литтл-Хардин: ночью на балконе дерутся призраки смотрителей, а около 01:30 в море виден светящийся корабль-призрак. К востоку от маяка на дне лежит уникальный «Проклятый нож».

items.name: Haunted Marbelle Hotel (Silent Hill nod) and its safe
items.landmark: Marbelle Hotel, NW 8th Street, next to the highway, east of the Pawn and Gun shop
items.spot: Enter from the rear; stairs past red writing ('BURN TO DUST' graffiti per one guide) lead to the roof, which is wrapped in fog; safe (TitanVault keypad) is on the ground floor
items.what: Abandoned hotel with a fog sequence read by fans and press as a Silent Hill homage. Pick up the 'Old Note' on the foggy roof - the code is circled on it - then open the ground-floor safe. Reward: cash and the collectible Crowex Ambassador 'Breakfast' watch. Unusual six-digit code.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Bloody Disgusting, Sportskeeda, ShowGamer, tracker.gg, TalkEsport
items.desc_ru: Заброшенный отель Marbelle на юге Кросстауна - отсылка к Silent Hill: крыша затянута туманом, там лежит записка с кодом 955214. Сейф на первом этаже хранит деньги и коллекционные часы Crowex.

items.name: La Llorona - ghost woman on the foggy road
items.area: Rural roads in eastern / north-eastern Lummox County
items.landmark: Road directly north of Bret's 'Killtelligence Provisions' marker (Game Rant); some players instead name Swamp Cabbage Rd in Emerald Springs
items.spot: Stretch of road where fog drifts across beneath a green street light; no fixed spawn point
items.conditions: Night, roughly 01:00-04:00. Be alone (use Split Up to send the partner home) and drive slowly.
items.what: Fog rolls in under a green lamppost, the car shuts down and a ghostly woman appears on the windshield (first person) in a short cutscene. If you get out and back in later she may be crying in the passenger seat. Compared by press to The Ring.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery (YouTube clips); Game Rant, Sportskeeda, Pocket-lint, games.gg
items.desc_ru: Ночью (01:00-04:00) на сельской дороге на востоке округа Ламмокс под зелёным фонарём сгущается туман, машина глохнет, и на лобовом стекле появляется женщина-призрак - Ла Йорона. Точная дорога у разных игроков называется по-разному.

items.name: Capri sacrificial ritual (pentagram warehouse)
items.region: Mariana County (Capri, western shore south of Port Gellhorn)
items.landmark: Abandoned warehouse next to Top Fun Drones, across from the railway
items.spot: Ground floor: blood (some say chalk) pentagram with a human-shaped outline, ringed by candles; a journal lies nearby; upper floor is used in the encounter
items.conditions: Near the game's starting area, so reachable early.
items.what: Knock out an NPC outside, carry the body in and drop it on the outline. Your partner is then heard calling for help upstairs and a demon appears; only fire hurts it, and burning the body ends the encounter.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Bloody Disgusting, Game8, Sportskeeda, ShowGamer, Red Bull
items.desc_ru: Заброшенный склад на севере Капри рядом с Top Fun Drones: на полу пентаграмма со свечами. Если положить на контур оглушённого NPC, появится демон, которого берёт только огонь.

items.name: Circles of Hell House - start of the Satan boss fight
items.region: Port Gellhorn (county not stated in the sources read)
items.landmark: House with an open garage, north of the 'Stash House' illegal operation
items.spot: Garage with two metalheads (Beelzebub and Dave) playing music
items.conditions: Night only (players recommend 00:00-04:00); if the garage is closed, come back later. Earliest practical point is Chapter 2 ('Paradise Lost'), when Port Gellhorn opens. Not character-exclusive.
items.what: Listen to the music until a prompt appears ('Having Fun?' in one guide, 'Rock On' in another) and say the music is good. You are then sent to a campfire (see 'Hell campfire and throne'), where looking into the fire teleports you to hell. One guide names the ritual 'Dethrone the Pretender' and says the boss is 'the Pretender' rather than Satan.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; GAMINGbible, Sportskeeda, Dread Central, YouTube
items.desc_ru: Дом с открытым гаражом на севере Порт-Геллхорна, где ночью играют двое металлистов. Похвалите их музыку - и вас отправят к костру, через который можно попасть в ад на бой с Сатаной.

items.name: Hell campfire and throne (Satan fight, Hellspawn Comshot 12)
items.landmark: North-west of the Thrillbilly Mud Club
items.spot: Campfire (hold interact to look into the fire) and a large throne at the campsite
items.conditions: Night; after talking to the metalheads at the Circles of Hell House.
items.what: Looking into the fire teleports you to hell: you start with a shotgun and fight demons to the centre of an arena where Satan waits. His health bar is hidden until you shoot the exploding enemies and animals (black goats) he summons. After the fight, use the big throne at the campsite for a final round. Rewards: legendary Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun and a reported permanent max-health upgrade.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; GAMINGbible, Sportskeeda, Beebom, GTABase, Dread Central
items.desc_ru: Лагерь с костром и троном на севере округа Келли, к северо-западу от клуба Thrillbilly. Взгляд в огонь переносит в ад на бой с Сатаной; награда - легендарный дробовик Hellspawn Comshot 12 и постоянный бонус к здоровью.

items.name: Hyde Island hunt (Manhunt / Saw homage)
items.area: Hyde Island, a remote island off Leonida's coast
items.spot: Locked shipping container with an old television
items.conditions: Explore the island alone (as Jason or Lucia); triggers automatically, no mission needed.
items.what: An unseen attacker tranquilizes you. You wake in a locked shipping container without your gear and with a collar on your neck; a mysterious figure (compared to Jigsaw and Manhunt's Director) speaks through an old TV, and after a ten-second countdown you are hunted by armed men and a dog. The island's exact map position was not captured in the sources read.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Dexerto, Bloody Disgusting, Screen Realm, Pocket-lint
items.desc_ru: На отдалённом острове Хайд героя усыпляют дротиком: он просыпается в запертом контейнере с ошейником, а неизвестный по старому телевизору объявляет охоту. Отсылка к Manhunt и «Пиле».

items.name: The literal Easter egg: painted-egg nest on the Bluegrass Radio Mast
items.area: South of Bluegrass (guides variously say 'Vice City's tallest tower', 'Leonida's tallest radio tower' and 'a tower north of Hamlet')
items.landmark: Bluegrass Radio Mast (name per GTA Wiki) - the tallest radio tower
items.spot: Very top of the mast: a bird's nest filled with brightly painted eggs
items.conditions: Long ladder climb, about 5-7 minutes.
items.what: Pick up an egg and throw it off the tower to trigger a short secret cutscene (GameSpot: you can aim it at a real-estate agent standing below; another guide says it lands on a car). No trophy or reward reported; the top doubles as a BASE-jump spot. The exact map pin was still listed as 'to be verified' by one guide.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery shared on social media; GameSpot, Sportskeeda, Red Bull, GTA Wiki
items.desc_ru: На самой вершине высочайшей радиомачты (Bluegrass Radio Mast, округ Вайс-Дейл) лежит гнездо с раскрашенными пасхальными яйцами. Если сбросить яйцо вниз, включится секретная сценка; подъём занимает 5-7 минут.

items.name: Dexter Morgan's apartment (Trinity Apartments), kill kit and boat
items.landmark: Trinity Apartments, near the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones shop
items.spot: Second-floor north-western corner unit, close to the water (exterior only, door locked); rooftop of the building (kill kit); docks next to the building (boat)
items.what: Waterfront apartment block recreating Dexter's Miami condo. On the roof lies a kill kit (syringe, toolbox, gloves, knife). A drivable boat resembling Dexter's 'Slice of Life' is moored at the nearby docks - guides disagree on whether it actually carries that name (one says it is a plain Lure Predator L35P).
items.origin: Post-launch discovery credited to the DETONATED social account; GameSpot, Dexerto, Bloody Disgusting, Dread Central, Dot Esports
items.desc_ru: Жилой комплекс Trinity Apartments на острове Вашингтон (Вайс-Бич) повторяет квартиру Декстера Моргана из сериала. Внутрь не попасть, но на крыше лежит «набор убийцы», а у причала стоит лодка, похожая на Slice of Life.

items.name: Cool Dog - the jet-ski dog rescue, and Dog Island
items.area: Open water; most often reported in Gambit Bay, directly west of Key Lento
items.spot: No fixed spawn marker
items.conditions: No mission requirement. Be stranded in open water far from land and from your boat for several minutes (about five), or drain stamina by swimming. If he does not appear, hop between different boats to reset the 'stranded' state.
items.what: A dog in sunglasses arrives on a jet ski and rescues you. Stay on the jet ski after the rescue and he takes you to Dog Island, where a wallet/stash holds $1,218 (about $1,200). Game8 notes you can also travel to the island directly.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery (viral clips); Game8, Beebom, Yahoo, GameSpot, Playday
items.desc_ru: Если оказаться в открытом море далеко от берега и лодки (чаще всего в заливе Гамбит западнее Ки-Ленто), через несколько минут на помощь приплывёт пёс в тёмных очках на гидроцикле. Не слезайте - он отвезёт на Собачий остров с тайником на $1 218.

items.name: Michael's yacht from GTA V (and the 'Wind Chimes' ringtone)
items.spot: Boat moored outside Jason's house; check the dashboard display
items.what: The boat resembles Michael De Santa's stolen Marquis from GTA V, and its dashboard screen shows the GTA V mini-map. Related nod: the 'Wind Chimes' ringtone Michael used is selectable in the phone settings under Ringtones.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; KeenGamer, Red Bull, BuzzFeed, Mobalytics
items.desc_ru: У дома Джейсона на Ки-Ленто пришвартована яхта, похожая на угнанную Marquis Майкла из GTA V; на её приборной панели видна мини-карта GTA V. В телефоне можно выбрать и рингтон Майкла Wind Chimes.

items.name: Paul Walker's Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious (Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF)
items.area: Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands, east of Vice City
items.landmark: Mansion/villa in the centre of the island (on your left when heading toward Vice Beach)
items.spot: Locked garage attached to the mansion
items.conditions: Some players do not see the car on the first visit and must return later.
items.what: A green modified car modelled on Brian O'Conner's 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse. Break the garage lock (Snap Gun or force), hotwire with a Slim Jim and cut the garage alarm before leaving. Registration reported as $6,750 (Dexerto) or free if it is your first car brought to Moses (TechWiser). Outlier locations in single guides: northern Capri near Tortoise Lake (EZG), 'Neptune Circle' (thebestmods).
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; VICE, PCGamesN, Dexerto, Jalopnik, Insider Gaming, Beebom
items.desc_ru: В запертом гараже особняка в центре острова Веспуччи (острова Риальто) стоит зелёный тюнингованный Penumbra FF - копия Mitsubishi Eclipse Пола Уокера из «Форсажа». Замок нужно взломать; иногда машина появляется не с первого визита.

items.name: Ghostbusters car - Declasse 'Ghost Exposed' Parkland
items.region: Mariana County (western shore, south of Port Gellhorn)
items.landmark: Halloween-decorated house on a residential block
items.spot: Station wagon parked outside the house
items.conditions: Appears in Chapter 2 after unlocking Moses' mod shop.
items.what: An Ecto-1 style wagon referencing GTA Online's 'Ghosts Exposed' event. Doors are unlocked (no Key Cloner needed); driving it unlocks its livery (called 'Spooked Out' in one report) at the vinyl mod shop.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Game Rant, Ghostbusters News
items.desc_ru: На Фортуна-стрит в Капри у дома, украшенного к Хэллоуину, стоит универсал в стиле Ecto-1 из «Охотников за привидениями». Двери открыты; поездка разблокирует его ливрею в тюнинг-ателье (со 2-й главы).

items.name: Mario & Luigi block ('Super Mario Bong') - J and L hats
items.area: Woods in the south-west / south of Moreau, north of Mount Kalaga, at the end of a twisty road
items.landmark: Ruins on the river (games.gg names them the ruined Lawton Co. Paper Mill)
items.spot: Purple tarp with a bong at the ruins; smoking column of the ruins; near-invisible block floating just above the main structure
items.what: Use the bong on the purple tarp, climb the ruins and stand in the smoke rising from one of the columns; a near-invisible block becomes visible above the ruin. Jump into it (or shoot it) to break it and receive two caps: a red (one guide says pink) 'J' cap for Jason and a green 'L' cap for Lucia.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Kotaku, GameSpot, Nintendo Life, TweakTown, Sportskeeda
items.desc_ru: В лесу на юго-западе Моро (округ Ламмокс, севернее горы Калага) у руин лежит фиолетовый брезент с бонгом. Покурив и встав в дым на руинах, вы увидите парящий блок - разбейте его и получите кепки «J» и «L» в стиле Марио и Луиджи.

items.name: 'Looney Tunes Wall' - painted fake tunnel
items.landmark: Three-way junction on a highway access road, near the Fufu clothing store
items.spot: Solid wall painted with a mural of the road continuing under a bridge
items.what: A Wile E. Coyote-style gag: drivers who believe the mural crash into the wall and take damage. No reward.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; TheGamer, Game Rant, TechJuice
items.desc_ru: В районе Vice Decor District у магазина Fufu на стене нарисован тоннель с уходящей вдаль дорогой - как в мультфильмах про Хитрого Койота. Игроки на скорости врезаются в глухую стену.

items.name: Red Hulk at McKittrick Farm (Kyle's mutant strawberries)
items.landmark: McKittrick Farm, north-east of the Starlet Motel and east of Port Gellhorn
items.spot: Farm (finale); the 'Pilot Wanted' flyer outside the Starlet Motel reception office starts the chain
items.conditions: Starts in Chapter 2 (flyer at the Starlet Motel); the transformation happens when Kyle calls again in Chapter 3. Eating the strawberry is optional.
items.what: Side missions for farmer Kyle McKittrick ('Investigate the Pilot', 'Collect Chemicals for Kyle' - reward $1,000 and an offered mutated strawberry). In Chapter 3 his experiments turn him into a huge red-skinned brute resembling Marvel's Red Hulk (a parody, not a crossover); a helicopter is involved in the finale per Russian coverage.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Dexerto, Kotaku, Yahoo, Game8
items.desc_ru: Ферма Маккиттрика во Фрогсуотере (округ Келли). Задания фермера Кайла о гигантской клубнике начинаются с листовки у мотеля Starlet и в 3-й главе заканчиваются его превращением в огромного «Красного Халка».

items.name: Tootsie, the talking cow
items.spot: Runaway show cow wearing a wreath, ribbons and a red blanket; follow the mooing
items.what: A farmer asks you to catch his runaway pageant cow. Catch and calm her and Tootsie starts talking, begging to be saved. Choice: return her to the farm (she will most likely be slaughtered) or set her free (the owner is displeased).
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Sportskeeda, Gfinity, iXBT, YouTube
items.desc_ru: В округе Келли у молочной фермы Howe Dairy фермер просит поймать сбежавшую нарядную корову Тутси. Успокоенная корова заговорит и попросит её спасти - можно вернуть её хозяину или отпустить.

items.name: Arthur Morgan's hat (Red Dead Redemption 2)
items.what: A cowboy hat resembling Arthur Morgan's can be bought at a yard sale. PC Gamer's Christopher Livingston documented it at $5; Leonida Verse lists $35.
items.origin: Post-launch discovery documented by PC Gamer (via BuzzFeed); Red Bull, Leonida Verse
items.desc_ru: На дворовой распродаже (блошином рынке) в Порт-Геллхорне за несколько долларов продаётся ковбойская шляпа, похожая на шляпу Артура Моргана из Red Dead Redemption 2.

items.name: Love Fist sticker at the Starlet Motel
items.spot: Sticker on one of the motel doors
items.what: A sticker of Love Fist, the rock band from GTA: Vice City.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; GTA Wiki, BuzzFeed, Red Bull
items.desc_ru: На одной из дверей мотеля Starlet наклеен стикер рок-группы Love Fist из GTA: Vice City.

items.name: Body Copy magazine with Fabien LaRouche (GTA V)
items.spot: A copy of Body Copy magazine lying in a house (which house is not stated in the sources read)
items.what: The magazine contains an article about Fabien LaRouche, the yoga instructor from GTA V.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; BuzzFeed, Red Bull, Business Upturn
items.desc_ru: В одном из домов лежит журнал Body Copy со статьёй о Фабьене Ларуше - инструкторе по йоге из GTA V. Точное место в источниках не указано.

items.name: 'Lethal by Design: A Liberty City Memoir' (GTA IV nod)
items.spot: Book inside the house
items.what: A readable memoir by a former Liberty City gangster recounting events from 2008, the year GTA IV takes place.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; fan wikis and Sport-Express
items.desc_ru: В доме Джейсона на Ки-Ленто лежит книга «Lethal by Design: A Liberty City Memoir» - мемуары бывшего бандита из Либерти-Сити о событиях 2008 года, времени действия GTA IV.

items.name: Western novel about a New Austin cowboy (Red Dead Redemption nod)
items.area: Millport (county not stated in the sources read)
items.spot: Readable novel inside the tavern
items.what: A readable Western novel tells the story of a cowboy in New Austin, a region of the Red Dead Redemption games.
items.origin: Found and documented by GameSpot; also listed on the GTA 6 info wiki
items.desc_ru: В таверне Jacob's Tavern в Миллпорте можно прочитать вестерн о ковбое из Нью-Остина - региона из серии Red Dead Redemption.

items.name: Belville house from the San Andreas 'Lil' Probe'Inn' photo, with a conspiracy garage
items.landmark: Palm-lined house matching the framed photo in the Lil' Probe'Inn bar of GTA San Andreas - The Definitive Edition (2021)
items.spot: Garage of the house (must be broken into)
items.what: The house teased in 2021 exists in the game. Its garage is a conspiracy theorist's hideout: his notes say he is trapped in Leonida (he could not buy a plane ticket to Los Santos or drive past the borders) and plans to escape by boat; a note on the wall singles out 'J' and 'L' as apparently immune to the barriers.
items.origin: Teased by Rockstar in the 2021 San Andreas remaster photo; located after launch by mapper 'Jared'; BuzzFeed, iXBT, fan sites
items.desc_ru: Дом в Белвилле (округ Леонард) совпадает с загадочной фотографией из бара Lil' Probe'Inn в ремастере San Andreas 2021 года. В гараже - логово конспиролога, уверенного, что он заперт в Леониде; на стене упомянуты «J» и «L».

items.name: Tony the talking parrot nod (GTA San Andreas)
items.what: Lists by BuzzFeed and others include a nod to Tony, the talking parrot from GTA San Andreas. The exact spot was not captured in the sources read; a talking parrot that points to a wall stash is separately reported at the Exotic Animals Front in Key Lento (see that entry) and may be the same thing.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; BuzzFeed
items.desc_ru: В игре есть отсылка к говорящему попугаю Тони из GTA San Andreas. Точное место в изученных источниках не указано (возможно, это попугай в зоомагазине-прикрытии на Ки-Ленто).

items.name: Snapmatic post: 'We got Race and Chase 7 before...'
items.spot: In-game Snapmatic feed on the phone (not a map location)
items.what: A Snapmatic post riffs on the 'we got ___ before GTA 6' meme, substituting 'Race and Chase 7' for GTA 7.
items.origin: Reported by Kotaku (cited by BuzzFeed)
items.desc_ru: В ленте Snapmatic на телефоне есть пост, обыгрывающий мем «мы получили ... раньше GTA 6»: вместо GTA 7 упомянута Race and Chase 7. Это не точка на карте.

items.name: Vercetti Estate revolvers and Vintage Vice City pack (official edition content)
items.spot: Edition bonus items, not a map location
items.conditions: Ultimate Edition content.
items.what: The Ultimate Edition's Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers carry Vice City styling 'sourced from the Vercetti Estate' (Tommy Vercetti's mansion); per GTA Wiki their serial numbers match the release dates of Vice City and Vice City Stories. The Vintage Vice City pack outfits echo Miami Vice's Sonny Crockett and Scarface's Gina Montana.
items.origin: Official Rockstar edition material; GTA Wiki, Red Bull, Sport-Express
items.desc_ru: Револьверы Hawk & Little Morgan из Ultimate Edition «происходят из поместья Версетти», а их серийные номера совпадают с датами выхода Vice City и Vice City Stories. Это бонус издания, а не место на карте.

items.name: Terminator 2 'box of roses' shotgun homage
items.landmark: Hospital (escape sequence at the end of Chapter 1)
items.spot: Double doors during the hospital escape
items.conditions: Story moment: final mission of Chapter 1. Not a free-roam spot.
items.what: An enemy walks through double doors carrying a gold box of roses and pulls a shotgun out of it, echoing the T-800 in Terminator 2.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; ComingSoon, Yahoo, Pocket-lint, Dread Central
items.desc_ru: В финальной миссии 1-й главы при побеге из больницы противник выходит из дверей с коробкой роз и достаёт из неё дробовик - как Т-800 в «Терминаторе 2».

items.name: Scarface crime-scene house
items.landmark: House sealed as a crime scene
items.spot: Bathroom of the house
items.conditions: Entering triggers alarms and the police arrive shortly after, so be quick.
items.what: A blood-soaked bathroom modelled on the chainsaw scene from Scarface (Screen Realm notes the chainsaw itself is absent here).
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; DETONATED, Screen Realm
items.desc_ru: Дом на юге Ки-Ленто, опечатанный как место преступления: залитая кровью ванная отсылает к сцене с бензопилой из «Лица со шрамом». При входе срабатывает сигнализация и приезжает полиция.

items.name: Scarface motel room 3C with a chainsaw in the bathtub
items.spot: Bathtub
items.what: Reported second Scarface nod: a chainsaw resting in the bathtub of apartment 3C. Comes from guides that could not be cross-checked (one of them predates launch); a fandom page for a 'Scarface-inspired hotel' and a YouTube short exist, but the location was not confirmed by a second post-launch source.
items.origin: Fan guides / YouTube short
items.desc_ru: По неподтверждённым данным, в мотеле на юге Оушен-Бич в номере 3C в ванне лежит бензопила - ещё одна отсылка к «Лицу со шрамом». Вторым независимым источником не подтверждено.

items.name: Tony Montana-style mansion
items.what: One guide says a Starfish Island mansion mirrors Tony Montana's Miami estate from the 1983 film Scarface. Single source.
items.origin: One fan guide surfaced in search results (exact page not identified; candidates listed)
items.desc_ru: По одному из гайдов, особняк на Старфиш-Айленд повторяет поместье Тони Монтаны из «Лица со шрамом». Подтверждений из других источников нет.

items.name: 'Petty Forever' sticker (Tom Petty tribute)
items.spot: Sticker on a shop door (shop not identified in the sources read)
items.what: A 'Petty Forever' sticker is described as a tribute to Tom Petty (the first trailer used his song).
items.origin: Single fan guide
items.desc_ru: На двери одного из магазинов якобы есть наклейка «Petty Forever» - дань памяти Тому Петти. Место не уточнено, источник один.

items.name: Liberty City sports-team trading cards
items.spot: Collectible cards (not a single map location)
items.what: Collectible trading cards reference sports teams from earlier games' cities, such as the Liberty City Swingers and Penetrators.
items.origin: Fan wiki summary
items.desc_ru: Среди коллекционных карточек встречаются команды из прошлых игр серии - например, Liberty City Swingers и Penetrators.

items.name: Phil's Ammu-Nation = Phil Cassidy? (unproven link)
items.what: Players speculate the store is tied to Phil Cassidy from the 3D-era games. Russian coverage explicitly notes the connection is not proven.
items.origin: Player speculation; Sport-Express
items.desc_ru: Игроки связывают магазин Phil's Ammu-Nation с Филом Кэссиди из старых частей, но эта связь не доказана.

items.name: Top Gun nod
items.what: Movie-reference roundups mention a Top Gun nod; no details or location were captured in the sources read.
items.origin: Movie-reference lists (Pocket-lint and others)
items.desc_ru: В подборках кино-отсылок упоминается отсылка к «Топ Гану», но подробностей и места в изученных источниках нет.

items.name: Ocean View Hotel callback (GTA: Vice City)
items.what: Russian and wiki coverage lists the Ocean View (Tommy Vercetti's first safehouse in Vice City) among the Vice City callbacks, mentioning a white-on-yellow Oceanic parked outside as in the 2002 game. Details and exact position were not captured.
items.origin: Fan wiki / Sport-Express
items.desc_ru: Среди отсылок к Vice City называют отель Ocean View - первое убежище Томми Версетти; по описаниям, рядом припаркован бело-жёлтый Oceanic, как в игре 2002 года. Точное место не уточнено.

items.name: Mount Kalaga summit stone circle
items.spot: Circle of standing stones with a stacked stone pile in the middle and lanterns left behind
items.conditions: One guide says the circle only appears as a meditation spot after every other meditation has been completed.
items.what: An unexplained stone formation that players treat as GTA 6's answer to the Mount Chiliad mystery (it echoes the ritual sites of Red Dead Redemption 2). Fans suspect it could trigger another UFO event; no solution is known. Mentioned by several guides, though one fan site notes the circle itself had only single-source backing when it wrote.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Sportskeeda, ShowGamer, fan guides
items.desc_ru: На вершине горы Калага стоит круг из камней с пирамидкой в центре и брошенными фонарями - местный аналог тайны горы Чилиад. Назначение круга неизвестно, загадка не решена.

items.name: Mount Kalaga meteorite crash site
items.landmark: Near the summit of Mount Kalaga
items.spot: Campsite with a flattened tent and a smoking crater with scorched ground
items.what: A freshly fallen meteorite can be picked up from the crater. Its purpose is unconfirmed; guides say it can be sold at pawn shops. Possibly connected to the meteorite-chunk collectibles and the Burg Industries underwater research logs (not confirmed).
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Sportskeeda, ShowGamer, Red Bull, fan guides
items.desc_ru: Недалеко от вершины горы Калага - раздавленная палатка и дымящийся кратер со свежим метеоритом. Камень можно подобрать и продать в ломбарде; зачем он нужен ещё, пока неизвестно.

items.name: Mount Kalaga tower shed code
items.what: One fan guide gives a keypad code for a shed at the Mount Kalaga tower (also a BASE-jump spot). Not corroborated elsewhere.
items.origin: Single fan guide (grandleonida.com)
items.desc_ru: По одному фанатскому гайду, сарай у вышки на горе Калага открывается кодом 69185. Другими источниками не подтверждено.

items.name: Monument of Leonidan Supremacy (star-map statue mystery)
items.area: North of Port Gellhorn; other reports place it near Manifest Canyon
items.spot: Horse statues with metal 'star map' pieces on their heads; carved stars and geometric patterns on the stone pedestal; one horse wears a traffic cone
items.what: A WAiNK sculpture scan point (hold d-pad up to open the scanner). Near it the controller vibrates and a beeping signal plays that some players read as Morse code. Fan theory: the pedestal carvings align with the map's topographic lines. The traffic cone is read as a nod to Glasgow's Duke of Wellington statue (Rockstar North is Scottish). No solution confirmed.
items.origin: Post-launch player theory; kantan.news, gtavioffair.com; WAiNK sculpture lists by Push Square and GTABase
items.desc_ru: Монумент «Превосходства Леониды» к северу от Порт-Геллхорна: на головах коней закреплены металлические «звёздные карты», рядом вибрирует геймпад и слышен писк, похожий на азбуку Морзе. Игроки ищут здесь новую «тайну Чилиада»; решения пока нет.

items.name: SOS island ('#SendBeer')
items.region: Gulf of Leonida, off Mariana County (written 'Marina County' in some guides)
items.area: Guides disagree: a tiny palm-tree island in Leonida Bay directly above the military air base; a remote island far west of Watson Bay and the Grassrivers wetlands; or a sandbar west of the Keys
items.spot: Beach with 'SOS' and '#sendbeer' spelled out in trash and beer cans; a mobile phone lies on the ground near the SOS sign
items.conditions: Reach it by boat.
items.what: Castaway scene: the phone holds a video of what happened on the island (the stranded man drank the island's beer stock). Described as an unsolved mini-mystery.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Sportskeeda, Prodigygamers, ShowGamer
items.desc_ru: Крошечный остров в заливе Леониды у берегов округа Мариана: на песке мусором и пивными банками выложено «SOS» и «#sendbeer», рядом лежит телефон с видеозаписью. Точное положение острова гайды описывают по-разному.

items.name: 'Leonida mural theory' clues (palm-frond motif, UV paint under a bridge)
items.what: A fan-wiki page logs unconfirmed 'Chiliad-style' clues such as a recurring palm-frond motif and UV-reactive paint under a bridge. The page itself states that nothing is confirmed; no second source describes these objects.
items.origin: Fan theory page (gta6wiki.io)
items.desc_ru: Фанатская «теория мурала Леониды»: повторяющийся мотив пальмовой ветви и светящаяся в ультрафиолете краска под мостом. Ничем не подтверждено - исключайте из карты.

items.name: 'Deep-Sea Research Blacksite' and hidden 'second map'
items.what: One blog claims a deep-sea blacksite and a larger hidden 'second map', citing unverified datamine/telemetry. Not supported by any guide; do not confuse with the real Burg Industries underwater facilities.
items.origin: Speculative blog post (leonidainsider.com)
items.desc_ru: Утверждения о «глубоководной секретной базе» и скрытой «второй карте» основаны на непроверенных «датамайнах». Подтверждений нет - не путать с настоящими подводными станциями Burg Industries.

items.name: José Bermúdez at the Friends of Freedom landmark (start of the President Russo bunker hunt)
items.area: Eastern Downtown Vice City, Catalan Blvd
items.spot: Veteran NPC who calls you over near the monument; his apartment is in Little Cuba (NW 4th Avenue per one post)
items.conditions: He only appears during the day.
items.what: Talk to the veteran, then visit his Little Cuba apartment: a tape recorder (and a photo pointing to Sharktooth Island) reveals the bunker codes. Starts the 'President Russo' world event that leads to two bunkers and a free tank.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Beebom, Sportskeeda, KeenGamer, TechWiser
items.desc_ru: Днём у монумента Friends of Freedom в восточном Даунтауне ветеран Хосе Бермудес даёт первую зацепку. В его квартире в Литтл-Кубе диктофон и фото раскрывают коды президентских бункеров.

items.name: President's Bunker on Sharktooth Island
items.area: Sharktooth Island - described as north of Waning Sands / south of Little Hardin Island / north-east of Leonard County
items.spot: Bunker door with a keypad
items.conditions: Codes are learned at José Bermúdez's apartment, but the keypad accepts the code directly.
items.what: First of two presidential bunkers. The code is the birthdate of President Joe S. Russo. Sportskeeda's walkthrough lists loot inside (details not captured). One outlier guide swaps the order and puts the first bunker at Big Pine.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Beebom, Sportskeeda, KeenGamer, khelnow, GTA BOOM
items.desc_ru: Первый президентский бункер на острове Шарктус у северо-восточного побережья. Дверь открывает код 010317 - дата рождения президента Джо Руссо.

items.name: Second presidential bunker near Big Pine (free tank)
items.region: North-west of Grassrivers (one guide: Mariana County)
items.area: Big Pine (one guide adds 'near Tola Bay')
items.spot: Hidden bunker entrance/hatch; control room with a switch / red button inside
items.what: Enter the code on the tree keypad to open the bunker. Pressing the control-room button opens the way to a military tank that is free to take and respawns there if lost. One guide says finding the tank unlocks a secret mission to assassinate President Joe Russo; another mentions a legendary weapon inside. Additional codes 5297 and 2975 are reported inside the bunker (door/safe/hatch), but guides do not agree on how they are used.
items.codes: 085355 (tree keypad); 5297 and 2975 reported for interior locks (unclear)
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Beebom, Sportskeeda, KeenGamer, Gadget Bridge, Prodigygamers
items.desc_ru: Второй бункер спрятан у Биг-Пайн к северо-западу от Грассриверс: код 085355 вводится на панели, прикреплённой к дереву. Красная кнопка в пункте управления открывает ангар с бесплатным танком.

items.name: Freddie's prepper outpost bunker
items.what: A bunker inside a prepper's outpost, described by one guide; appears to be a separate secret from the President Russo bunkers.
items.origin: Single guide (games.gg)
items.desc_ru: По одному гайду, на севере округа Леонард в лагере выживальщика Фредди есть отдельный секретный бункер. Вторым источником не подтверждено.

items.name: Mile Zero Air Station (restricted military base)
items.spot: Whole island base is a restricted area; front gate
items.conditions: Soldiers attack on entry.
items.what: The game's restricted military base (counterpart to GTA V's Fort Zancudo). Get in via a stunt jump or by ramming the front gate; a fighter jet and a tank can be stolen.
items.origin: Post-launch guides; Insider Gaming, GTABase, Beebom, Yahoo
items.desc_ru: Закрытая военная база Mile Zero Air Station на острове Гус-Ки (юго-запад округа Мариана). Солдаты стреляют по нарушителям, но отсюда можно угнать истребитель и танк.

items.name: Burg Industries underwater research facilities (five)
items.area: Reported spots: off Harden (Hardin) Island on the east side of the map; north of the military base; east of Key Lento; the Sandbars; plus the 'meteorite' facility
items.spot: Submerged research stations with equipment and computers; one has a large meteorite and a separate safe below the structure
items.conditions: Scuba gear and a boat. Exact coordinates were not captured in the sources read.
items.what: Five hidden underwater stations operated by Burg Industries. Computer logs contain confidential messages about searching the seabed for meteorites on behalf of a billionaire and about Burg 'altering the statistics'. Belpoint Strait, sometimes named alongside them, is a treasure dive site and not a confirmed facility entrance.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Sportskeeda, Item Level Gaming, games.gg, YouTube
items.desc_ru: Вокруг Леониды на дне спрятаны пять подводных исследовательских станций Burg Industries. В компьютерах - секретная переписка о поиске метеоритов для миллиардера; у одной станции лежит большой метеорит и сейф.

items.name: RV Park bunker with the legendary 'Type 9' SMG
items.area: RV park in south-west Vice City (possibly the 'Sunrise RV Park' named in code lists)
items.spot: Bunker
items.what: Early-game loot room holding a legendary 'Type 9' SMG, per the DETONATED loot-room list. A code 6769 is attached to 'Sunrise RV Park' in code lists, but its exact use is marked uncertain.
items.origin: DETONATED / Grand Leonida loot-room guides
items.desc_ru: По гайду DETONATED, в бункере на стоянке трейлеров на юго-западе Вайс-Сити лежит легендарный ПП Type 9. Код 6769 для Sunrise RV Park указан как неуточнённый.

items.name: Derelict Spy Vessel
items.spot: A meteorite chunk lies on a beach about 100 ft north of it
items.what: A derelict vessel named only as a reference point in GTABase's meteorite map notes; nothing else about it was captured.
items.origin: GTABase interactive map note
items.desc_ru: Заброшенное «шпионское судно» на восточном берегу Ки-Ленто, упомянутое в заметках карты GTABase как ориентир для метеорита. Подробностей нет.

items.name: Teddy bear factory (Apollo Aggregates warehouse) loot
items.area: South-east of Hamlet (one outlier guide says just north of Hamlet)
items.spot: Second office (safe); warehouse floor (weapons); teddy-bear vans (cocaine); rear shutter leading to another van
items.conditions: Available early. The guards are already dead: no enemies, no cops, no wanted level.
items.what: One of the best early cash spots: roughly $13,000 in cash and goods (some guides say $10,000+ or up to $20,000). The office safe (forced open / dial safe - guides differ, no code) holds the silver Leroy Rook collectible card, worth about $6,000 at a pawn shop.
items.origin: Post-launch guides; Beebom, KeenGamer, DETONATED, AlcastHQ, Sportskeeda
items.desc_ru: Красный склад Apollo Aggregates к юго-востоку от Хамлета - «фабрика плюшевых мишек». Охрана уже мертва: внутри около $13 000 наличными и товаром, а в сейфе - коллекционная карточка Leroy Rook за $6 000.

items.name: Crashed plane, dead pilot's note and the UNDAUNTED yacht (Bobcat Key map & stash)
items.area: A bank in Pelican Valley (crash site); Bobcat Key inlet; open sea straight west of the inlet (yacht)
items.spot: Broken cockpit with the pilot's corpse and a notepad; small yellow boat with a canopy at the marked Bobcat Key inlet; an inactive yacht out at sea
items.conditions: A separate free-roam 'plane crash' random event (hear/see a plane go down; pilot has narcotics, money and a flare gun; goons show up) may be related.
items.what: The notepad gives cryptic instructions mentioning 'Bobcat Key' and the 'UNDAUNTED Yacht'. Go to the Bobcat Key inlet, take the yellow boat and sail straight west until you find the drifting yacht where a deal went wrong; check the bodies in the water for loot. Shacknews documents the map and stash; the final stash details were not captured.
items.origin: Post-launch player discovery; Shacknews, YouTube, X (@GermanStrands)

items.what: Post-launch viral clip claiming to show GTA 6 running on PC. XDA found it combines GTA 6's title screen with recycled footage of GTA V running on PC. The game is PS5 / Xbox Series only.
items.origin: Post-launch hoax
items.desc_ru: ФЕЙК: вирусное видео «неофициального ПК-порта GTA 6» смонтировано из заставки GTA 6 и старых кадров GTA V на ПК.
